newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Savings Bank maintains rise on Estonia bourse.
newsitem.headline: Savings Bank maintains rise on Estonia bourse.

text.p: Estonia's bourse rose on Wenesday in brisk trade, led by Savings Bank.
Overall market volume was a lively 14.4 million kroons and the index rose by 0.43 points to 107.7.
Savings Bank was in the spotlight as it maintanied its recent rise, closing at 48.70 kroons versus 47.80 kroons on Tuesday in trade worth 5.4 million kroons.
Market leader Hansabank was also active at 5.3 million kroons but it closed down slightly at 106.25 kroons versus 106.75 kroons on Tuesday.
Hansabank announced on Wednesday that its net profit for the month of October was 23.1 million kroons.
"Hansabank's October results lured investors, but there has also been pressure to sell," one dealer said.
